# block 0.1.6 — notice disclosure

Declared license: **MIT**. Dependency role: transitive dependency through the
optional `metal` feature (`mageckrs` → `metal` → `block`).

The exact locked archive did not include complete release-specific notice text.
Available upstream evidence was reviewed, including the [0.1.6 source release](https://github.com/SSheldon/rust-block/tree/47178790cfc9d4a8b092051d8b413b78bd31254a),
its [MIT manifest declaration](https://github.com/SSheldon/rust-block/blob/47178790cfc9d4a8b092051d8b413b78bd31254a/Cargo.toml),
[notice issue](https://github.com/SSheldon/rust-block/issues/13), and
[proposed license-file addition](https://github.com/SSheldon/rust-block/pull/14).
That notice work was not merged for this release; an unmerged proposal is not
used as authoritative notice text.

MAGeCKrs accepts publication with this historical notice-evidence gap disclosed.
No redistribution prohibition was identified in the reviewed evidence. This does
not supply missing historical attribution, relicense the package, constitute
legal advice, or claim external legal clearance.
